# Altpool

> Altpool is a viem toolkit for the ERC-8421 alternative mempool on the EIP-8141 frame-transaction devnet (chain 1337): an SDK, an admission simulator with a frame-doctor CLI, an entity monitor, an MCP server, and the contracts and prover behind two demo apps, QuietSend (withdraw to a 0-ETH wallet with no relayer) and Pledge Paid. The demo proves the mechanism, not privacy. Alt-mempool verdicts before sending come from a rule model and are unverified until a node answers.

The full reference (API per package, runnable recipes, rule catalogue, CLI and MCP schemas, devnet facts) is one Markdown file: https://altpool.vercel.app/llms-full.txt . The same content as a web page: https://altpool.vercel.app/docs . Source: https://github.com/Ansh-Sonkusare/altpool

## Docs

- [Full reference (Markdown)](https://altpool.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): everything below in one file
- [Start here](https://altpool.vercel.app/docs#start-here): packages, install, MCP quick start
- [Recipes](https://altpool.vercel.app/docs#recipes): send a frame tx, stake an entity, check admission before signing, explain a rejected hash, QuietSend deposit and withdraw, Pledge Paid with payTx, watch an entity with webhook alerts, Wallet Bridge Mode A and B
- [SDK reference](https://altpool.vercel.app/docs#sdk-reference-altpool): client.altpool actions, types, errors with .fix
- [Simulator reference](https://altpool.vercel.app/docs#simulator-reference-altpool-simulator): checkAdmission, routing, diagnosis, vitest matchers
- [Monitor reference](https://altpool.vercel.app/docs#monitor-reference-altpool-monitor): watchEntity, entityStatus, webhookAlerts
- [Contracts reference](https://altpool.vercel.app/docs#contracts-reference-altpool-contracts): exitTx, payTx, frame layouts, deployed addresses
- [Rule catalogue](https://altpool.vercel.app/docs#rule-catalogue): every RuleId, ERC-8421 code, trigger and fix
- [CLI and MCP reference](https://altpool.vercel.app/docs#cli-and-mcp-reference): frame-doctor, watch-entity, quietsend, demo, MCP tool schemas
- [Devnet facts and gotchas](https://altpool.vercel.app/docs#devnet-facts-and-gotchas): endpoints, gateway vs miner, gas limits, staking, nonces, state gas

## Optional

- [Limits and honesty](https://altpool.vercel.app/docs#limits-and-honesty): what is and is not verified
